$comment: Relay v2 replay protection (protocol 4), shared by the computer (crates/nekko-remote, tests/golden.rs), the iPhone (apps/ios/Protocol, RelayClientTests) and Android (apps/android/protocol, RelayClientTest). The agent seals `challenge.frame` to a connection when the relay announces it (client-open); the phone opens it and answers with exactly `hello` (its own deviceId, name and platform; pair only when enrolling); every request after the welcome carries the same challenge and a seq that starts at 1 and goes up by one (`requests`). `legacyHello` is what a phone sends to a computer that never challenged it. Sealed with AES-256-GCM under PBKDF2-SHA256(secret, "nekko-relay:" + room, 100000), IV first, base64.
